meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用数据讲出有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在汇报中把数据讲得动人
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your data presentations more compelling.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按「铺垫→冲突→解决」的结构把原始数据组织成叙事,配合图表和对比来呈现洞察,产出数据报告、季度业务回顾或高管演示这类内容。
howto.when: 当你向干系人展示分析、写数据报告或做高管演示时会用它。原文另列了季度业务回顾、投资人演示等场景。

say.text: 帮我把这组季度数据整理成给高管看的叙事报告
say.note: 按铺垫—冲突—解决组织内容

say.text: 这个洞察该放在开头还是结尾?给我结构建议
say.note: 它会建议把关键结论前置

say.text: 把这份分析改写成面向非技术听众的版本
say.note: 会减少术语、对齐听众词汇

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude structures raw data into a narrative (setup, conflict, resolution) using charts, context and comparisons, producing data reports, quarterly business reviews or executive presentations.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to stakeholders, writing data reports or building executive presentations. The original also lists quarterly reviews and investor decks.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly data into an executive narrative report
Should this insight go first or last? Give me the structure
Rewrite this analysis for a non-technical audience
